item.description: p∞l 0.7.4 can carry KILN as an optional, verified companion application. Members with KILN access can install and open it directly from the KILN tab; Pool copies only the application into that member's own Applications folder and does not bundle or download the KILN firing archive.

p∞l 0.7.3 fixes the blank private Selector workspace by allowing only the exact Selector origin supplied by the authenticated team server. Selector remains independently protected by the studio tailnet and does not download its full audio library to the Mac.
This release also adds a per-person KILN tab for entitled members. KILN stays a separately installed local instrument: Pool opens its fixed macOS application identity without bundling KILN or copying its local firing archive.

p∞l 0.7.2 adds per-person application access tied to each existing team token. The server now decides which top-level applications a member can see and use; grants and revocations synchronize without reinstalling Pool. An administrator-configured private Selector can appear as a full-window Pool application while retaining its own independent network identity checks. BRAIN remains hidden and its historical records remain preserved.
